cases.why: Stage 8c phase 2 untracked index.html and dist/ because a generated file under version control made every branch touching the template collide with whatever CI regenerated on main -- five conflicts in one day across three branches. Adding either path back to a file_pattern reinstates that tax, and does it quietly: the symptom appears on somebody else's open branch days later, not in the run that caused it.

src/prune_build_churn.py was deleted because untracking the artifacts removed the churn it managed. A step calling it would fail the run outright; worse is a workflow that merely NAMES it, which reads as a protection that is present while nothing enforces anything -- the exact shape this repo recorded as 'a guard wired into one of several paths reads as a guard that is present'.
cases.replace:
- name: Drop churn
        run: python src/prune_build_churn.py

      - name: Commit and push changes
